caption: The drawing depicts a richly patterned, rectangular section bordered by a thick band with geometric shapes in brown, yellow, blue, and white. The primary background color is a deep reddish-brown. Within the main area, there are large, stylized floral motifs in shades of light blue, yellow, white, and green, with darker outlined details and scattered green leaves. The flowers vary in size and orientation, with some petals outlined in black or brown for definition. The composition is divided into three main sections by two perpendicular geometric borders, one running vertically and one running horizontally near the upper-left quadrant. Each border features a repeating sequence of diamond and triangular shapes filled with brown, blue, yellow, and white. The overall pattern is symmetrical, and the name "P. Jenner" is written in the lower right corner of the patterned section. The drawing is set against a plain cream or beige background, with faint discolorations near the top.
